Messages.Author: Martin Bergstrom
Messages.Body:
Something strange happened with the first attempt, lets make another try :)

I recently started playing the game, and have a few Jyhad/V:TES questions:

1. Can a minion have two identical retainers (for example two
Raven Spy)

2. Can a minion have and use two identical equipment cards (Two flak
jackets)?

3. I read in this newsgroup that the clan hosers having clan symbols
in VTES is a misprint, however the errata I have read doesn't
mention this. Is there official errata anywhere that contains
this ruling?

4. Another fact learned from this newsgroup is that Steal Blood doesnt
burn a vampire in the full game when you steal all the blood
the vampire has. Is this clarified in any ruling anywhere?
From the VTES rules I would assume that the vampire should
burn.

5. Can Anneke really block any Metusalehs vampires?

6. If a vampire with 2 current blood is hit by 2 normal and 2 agg.
damage in one strike, can I choose to prevent the 2 agg damage
and only take the normal damage, or do I have to prevent normal
damage first?

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
mart...@Minsk.DoCS.UU.SE (Martin Bergstrom) writes:
>1. Can a minion have two identical retainers (for example two Raven Spy)

Yes.

>2. Can a minion have and use two identical equipment cards (Two flak
> jackets)?

Yes.

>3. I read in this newsgroup that the clan hosers having clan symbols
> in VTES is a misprint, however the errata I have read doesn't
> mention this. Is there official errata anywhere that contains
> this ruling?

Who knows? Official errata lists are *very* hard to come by - no one seems
to have the time to maintain one.

>4. Another fact learned from this newsgroup is that Steal Blood doesnt
> burn a vampire in the full game when you steal all the blood
> the vampire has. Is this clarified in any ruling anywhere?
> From the VTES rules I would assume that the vampire should
> burn.

Yes, in some Rules Team Ruling sheet. Good luck finding it on an
official FAQ, as always.

>5. Can Anneke really block any Metusalehs vampires?

Yes (card text). She cannot block her own Methuselah, of course.

>6. If a vampire with 2 current blood is hit by 2 normal and 2 agg.
> damage in one strike, can I choose to prevent the 2 agg damage
> and only take the normal damage, or do I have to prevent normal
> damage first?

You prevent any damage you like. Normally, you would choose to
prevent the agg first.
